checked against: Last checked on 2026-09-23. The two field lists below are the `inputSchema` of each tool in the `tools/list` result of `kscope mcp`, read from the public contract published with the release — the output of `kscope public-contract` for that build — which also carries the batch bound, the stdio transport, and `operator_commands_in_mcp: false`. `kscope mcp` needs a key; `kscope schema search`, `kscope schema remember` and `kscope public-contract` do not, so a reader without a key can still check this file.
what this is: The two tools an agent sees when it connects to Kaleidoscope, and the fields each one takes.
what this is not: The schema itself. This file is written here and checked against the engine; the engine's tools/list is the authority, and a build may accept less than this file lists. Read the schema your own host discovered before you rely on a field. Two fields that `kscope --help` names as knobs of the command-line `call search` -- bfs_depth and max_facts -- are refused by the MCP inputSchema and are therefore absent above. Whether Kaleidoscope is released, and to whom, is not stated here: that is one fact and it lives in the release metadata this site is built from.
